text:
li: quick sync: reentrancy + streaming retry behaviour — we observed a case where a hedged retry resumed mid-stream and duplicated side-effects. thinking through constraints and short-term guardrails.

anya: do we have reproduction steps? is it specific to chunked responses or general retry glue?

li: repro: client opens streaming generate -> edge forwards to model v1 -> slow tail triggers hedge to model v2 -> both send partial chunks -> upstream resume allowed without checkpointing -> duplicate commit observed in downstream webhook.

jason: hmm. two axes: (1) client-visible resume tokens / checkpoints, (2) server-side idempotency / dedupe windows. prefer a light-weight resume token attached to trailers.

maria: resume tokens are fine, but we're trading latency for a heavier commit path. also KV cache semantics get weird if we allow mid-stream branch reads.

devbot: CI | streaming-retry-tests #42 passed on feature/stream-resume (linux-x86) :white_check_mark:

sre-robot: sample log showing duplication:
```
edge: forward req id=abc123 -> backendA
edge: hedge spawn backendB (deadline-hedge)
backendA: trailer resume_token="tkn-37"
backendB: trailer resume_token="tkn-38"
edge: both resume -> forwarded completion -> webhook called twice
```

anya: can we constrain hedging so only idempotent ops are hedged? or require hedged backends to assert a dedupe-key in trailers?

jason: propose: (a) hedged request MUST include an idempotency-key header; (b) edge maintains a short dedupe cache keyed by idempotency-key + sequence-window; (c) resume tokens are orthogonal and used for client-visible replay only.

maria: also add budgeted hedging: if downstream indicates write-affecting-chunks (via a header), we reduce hedge probability to 0 within the write-window.

li: agree. next steps: create small RFC with (1) idempotency-key requirement for hedges, (2) edge dedupe cache semantics (TTL, max entries), (3) resume token for client resume, (4) metric hooks for duplicate side-effect detection. I'll draft and ping architecture.

anya: thanks — add a short test harness simulating chunk interleaving and webhook dedupe assertions.

jason: I'll add the HTTP trailer schema and a small adapter for grpc->http-trailer mapping.

maria: I'll sketch the observability dashboard (duplicate-events rate, hedged-call ratio, dedupe cache hit/miss).

li: great. tagging followup: @architecture for RFC, @eng-runtime for dedupe cache impl. :thumbsup:
